_comment: Minimal demo config to pair with Seed-DemoLab.ps1. Pure manager-based routing (no group-to-reviewer mappings), which is the simplest story to narrate: each manager reviews their own reports. Grants whose owner has no manager land in the _unrouted package instead of being dropped.

compliance.summary: Evidences periodic review of user access rights and enforcement of least privilege, supporting access-recertification controls found in SOC 2 (CC6.1-CC6.3), ISO 27001 (A.5.18), HIPAA Security Rule (164.308(a)(4)), PCI DSS (Req. 7), and NIST 800-53 (AC-2).
